title: Env Paste
summary: Shows a pasted .env file as the loader will read it, so stray quotes, a ' #' that cuts a value short or duplicate keys don't slip through.
description: Catches .env slips loaders accept silently (stray or curly quotes, padded values, a ' #' that cuts a value short, duplicate keys, bad key names, empty values, test keys in production) by showing a parsed table of what the app will read, with one-tap fixes.
catches: Stray or curly quotes and padded values
An unquoted ' #' that turns the rest of the value into a comment
Duplicate keys (which one wins) and invalid key names
Empty values, and test keys in production
limits: Follows common dotenv parsing; your loader may treat quotes and comments differently
Masking is visual; the pasted text still holds the secrets
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid when there are errors
Parsed variables are a labelled list; each row can select its line in the field
server: Validate required environment variables when the app starts, and keep production secrets out of shared pastes.
